# railway_environment (Resource)

A Railway environment, created empty and without deploying anything. Pass its `id` as the `environment_id` of the resources that go in it. Destroying it deletes everything in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_environment" "preview" {
  project_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name       = "preview"
}

resource "railway_service" "web" {
  environment_id = railway_environment.preview.id
  name           = "web"
  source         = { image = { image = "traefik/whoami:v1.10" } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Environment name. Changing it renames the environment.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Changing it replaces the environment.

### Optional

- `source_environment_id` (String) Environment to copy services, variables and settings from when Railway creates this one. Terraform does not manage what Railway copies: import those resources, or leave this unset and declare them. Changing it replaces the environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Environment ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <environment_id>
terraform import railway_environment.preview 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
